seeds.solicitationTitle: IT Infrastructure Modernization & Managed Security Services

sections.executiveSummary:
Apex Federal Solutions LLC is uniquely positioned to deliver the full scope of IT Infrastructure Modernization and Managed Security Services required under DISA-HC-2026-R-0042. As an 8(a)-certified, veteran-owned small business with an active Secret facility clearance and a proven track record supporting DoD clients, Apex brings the precise combination of technical capability, mission understanding, and operational readiness DISA requires.

Our solution centers on three integrated pillars: (1) a phased infrastructure modernization approach grounded in DoD Zero Trust Architecture principles, (2) a mature 24/7 SOC capability staffed by cleared, CISSP-certified analysts with demonstrated sub-60-minute MTTD performance, and (3) a cloud migration methodology aligned with FedRAMP High authorization requirements and DoD Cloud Strategy directives. Apex has executed this exact capability stack for Air Force Materiel Command and the Department of Veterans Affairs, delivering measurable results — including a 91% reduction in MTTD and 100% on-schedule cloud migration — on contracts totaling over $5.8M.

Apex will deliver this contract at a total proposed value well within the Government's estimated ceiling, with no subcontractor dependency risk, full key personnel availability on Day 1, and a 30-day transition-in plan that ensures zero disruption to DISA's operational posture.
sections.technicalApproach:
Apex's technical approach is organized into four interconnected workstreams executed in a phased sequence:

WORKSTREAM 1 — INFRASTRUCTURE ASSESSMENT & DESIGN (Months 1–3): Our team will conduct a comprehensive baseline assessment of DISA's current network infrastructure, documenting all switching, routing, and wireless assets against DoD STIG benchmarks. We will produce an Infrastructure Modernization Roadmap (IMR) identifying priority upgrade areas, risk posture, and a sequenced remediation plan. All assessment tools (Nessus, Nmap, Rapid7) will be pre-authorized prior to use.

WORKSTREAM 2 — SOC STANDUP & 24/7 OPERATIONS (Months 1–2, then ongoing): Apex's SOC Director, Dr. Serena Washington (CISSP, SPLUNK Certified Architect), will lead a rapid 45-day SOC integration process — configuring SIEM ingestion rules, establishing baseline network behavior profiles, and onboarding DISA's existing log sources. The SOC will be fully operational by Day 45 with all SLAs active (P1: 15-min, P2: 1-hour response).

WORKSTREAM 3 — CLOUD MIGRATION (Months 3–18): Using our proven 5-phase cloud migration methodology (Discover → Assess → Plan → Migrate → Optimize), Apex will migrate prioritized on-premise workloads to DoD-authorized cloud environments. Each migration wave will include pre-migration testing, rollback planning, and a 30-day hypercare period post-cutover.

WORKSTREAM 4 — VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT (Ongoing): Monthly ACAS scans, POA&M generation and tracking, and critical/high remediation within the 30-day SLA. Apex will implement an automated vulnerability workflow using Tenable.sc integrated with a GRC platform to eliminate manual tracking gaps.
sections.managementPlan:
Marcus R. Thorne (PMP, CISSP, TS/SCI) will serve as Program Manager with direct accountability to DISA's COR. Dr. Serena Washington will serve as Lead Security Engineer and SOC Director. Both are available immediately upon award with no conflicts.

Apex employs a PMBOK-aligned program management framework with Agile sprint cycles for technical workstreams and monthly status reviews with DISA leadership. Our Quality Control Plan mandates peer review of all deliverables, dual-analyst review of all security incidents, and weekly internal retrospectives to identify and resolve emerging risks before they impact mission performance.

Risk management is continuous: our Risk Register is reviewed bi-weekly by the PM and updated after every significant operational event. Top-identified risks for this engagement include personnel turnover (mitigated by a bench of two cleared, qualified backup candidates for each key role) and cloud migration scope creep (mitigated by a formal change control process requiring COR approval for any scope modifications).
sections.pastPerformance:
Apex's two most relevant past performance references directly demonstrate our capability to execute the DISA requirement:

REFERENCE 1 — AFMC SOC Support (FA8773-23-C-0041, $3.1M, Oct 2023–Sep 2025): We operated a 24/7 SOC for Air Force Materiel Command across 3,200 endpoints at 4 installations. Reduced MTTD from 4.2 hours to 38 minutes in the first 90 days. Neutralized 14 active threats with zero successful intrusions. CPARS: Exceptional.

REFERENCE 2 — VA Cloud Migration (GS-35F-0042U, $2.75M, Jan 2022–Dec 2024): Migrated 1,800 workloads to AWS GovCloud for VA OIT, delivered 3 weeks early and $140K under budget. Post-migration uptime: 99.96%. Agency reported 22% reduction in infrastructure costs. CPARS: Exceptional.

These references, both accessible via the CPARS database, demonstrate Apex's ability to deliver at the intersection of SOC operations, infrastructure modernization, and cloud migration — precisely the capability scope required by DISA.

seeds.solicitationTitle: Administrative and Program Management Support Services

sections.executiveSummary:
Apex Federal Solutions LLC offers GSA's Office of Government-wide Policy a proven, low-risk administrative and program management support solution under Solicitation 47QRAA26Q0118. Having supported GSA OGP directly on Contract 47QRAA20Q0087 from 2021–2024, Apex brings institutional knowledge of OGP's mission, established relationships with program office staff, and a demonstrated track record of delivering executive-quality work products without error.

Our proposed team of six FTEs — all holding active security clearance eligibility, Microsoft 365 proficiency, and federal administrative experience — will be fully onboarded within 10 business days of award. We propose an LPTA-competitive labor rate structure that delivers maximum value without sacrificing quality.
sections.technicalApproach:
Apex's approach to administrative and program management support is built on three principles: responsiveness, precision, and proactive communication.

PROGRAM MANAGEMENT SUPPORT: Our PMs maintain live program schedules in Microsoft Project, updated daily. We facilitate weekly status meetings with pre-circulated agendas and deliver formatted meeting minutes within 2 business days — guaranteed by our internal QC checklist process.

DATA ANALYSIS & REPORTING: Our analysts are proficient in Excel (advanced pivot/VBA), Power BI (certified), and SharePoint. We will establish a live program dashboard within 30 days of award, providing OGP leadership real-time visibility into program status, milestones, and risks.

ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT: We implement a ticketing-based work order system for all administrative requests, ensuring no task falls through the cracks. All records are managed in compliance with NARA General Records Schedules and OGP's specific records retention policies.
sections.pastPerformance: Our most directly relevant reference is our prior GSA OGP engagement (47QRAA20Q0087, $890K, Apr 2021–Mar 2024). We supported 4 OGP program offices simultaneously, produced 48 executive briefings and 12 congressional packages, and earned a CPARS rating of 'Very Good.' We are uniquely positioned as an incumbent-equivalent on this requirement, with zero ramp-up risk and immediate operational readiness.
